_comment: dsh-personal-hub 共享清单（git 同步，机器无关）：声明个人 DSH 层的组合意图——插件列表、官方基底层、patch 注释。机器特定值一律不放这里：profileDir/pluginsDir 由插件运行时派生（$DSH_HOME 或 ~/.dsh + 本仓 plugins 目录），绝对路径覆盖（pythonPath/pwshPath 等）写进同目录 personal.local.json（gitignore，每台机器自建）。字段：plugins[].name=插件包名（目录名=包名，id=去 dsh- 前缀）；plugins[].patch.config=cordis.patch.yml 覆盖；extraBundles=非基座、非自研的功能 bundle（官方实验层等，按声明顺序排在自研插件之后）；removedBundles=显式从 profile 剔除的 bundle（reapply 时移除）；extraPatches=非插件绑定的部署覆盖。注：清单外的 bundle 一律【保留】并在界面上作提示、不算漂移——新版插件管理器允许在 GUI 里装/启用 bundle，reapply 不得静默吞掉它们；要真正移除请写进 removedBundles 或用 disable-plugin.mjs。

patch.comment: deepseek-balance: repoDir/opsDir derive from the sibling layout automatically.

restart-resume: auto-continue the session after an AI-triggered service restart.

extraPatches.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek
extraPatches.comment: web-search-deepseek: route web_search through the OpenCode Zen Go gateway (Anthropic Messages + server-side web_search_20250305; returns structured web_search_tool_result blocks). Requires the official-patches session-header patch, because this provider uses a private native fetch and cannot inherit the session header from the conversation adapter. Model choice is measured, not assumed: deepseek-v4-flash triggered the server tool 10/10 times, minimax-m3 only 2/5, qwen3.8-flash and minimax-m2.7 0/5 — the model decides whether to search, and a miss is a hard WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR rather than a prose-scraping fallback.
